name: Snapshot → Take
description: Save a snapshot of the given display.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The display to capture. Required if you have more than one display that can take snapshots.

config_entries.label: Filename
config_entries.description: The name of the file to write. If not given, a name is built from the display id and the current date and time. Only letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-` are kept, so the file is always written inside the snapshots folder. A `.bmp` ending is added if you leave it off.
